name: loader_browse
expect: initial Sample Loader frame: SD card folders and instrument list visible, red box on the selected item
selection moves down one entry in the Browser pane
focus moves to the right Sample Pool pane (red box moves)
selection moves down one slot in the Sample Pool pane
manual: Sample Loader: lists SD card folders/samples and instrument slots. Press [Left] or [Right] to navigate between the option windows; a red bounding box indicates the selected window. Press [Up] or [Down] or turn the jog wheel to navigate the selected list.

name: config_nav
expect: initial Configuration frame: General category selected, first option row highlighted
selection moves down to the next option
category switches to the next category (Left/Right selects the Category window, per the on-screen 'Category' button)
manual: Configuration screen: Up/Down navigates the selected list; Left/Right switches the focused window/category (Category button). A red/green box marks the focused row.

name: pattern_edit
expect: initial Pattern frame centered on row 8 of track 1 with the cursor cell outlined
cursor moves down one row, frame scrolls when needed
cursor moves back up one row
manual: Pattern screen: Up/Down moves the edit cursor by one row; the view follows the cursor. The active cell is outlined and its sub-column is highlighted.
